# Christchurch Rental Market Analysis

## Git & Development Workflow

**Version:** 1.0

**Maintainer:** Pooja

**Last Updated:** 21 July 2026

---

# 1. Purpose

This document defines the Git workflow, branch management strategy, and collaboration process used throughout the Christchurch Rental Market Analysis project.

### Objectives

- Maintain a stable development environment.
- Prevent accidental overwrites.
- Minimise merge conflicts.
- Ensure all deliverables are reviewed before becoming part of the project.
- Maintain a complete development history.

---

# 2. Repository Structure

| Branch | Purpose | Who Can Push/Merge |
|---------|---------|--------------------|
| `main` | Final production version used for project submission | Pooja only |
| `pre-prod` | Stable weekly release containing reviewed and verified code | Pooja only |
| `staging` | Shared integration branch where completed team work is combined | Entire Team |
| `pooja` | Personal development branch for Pooja | Pooja |
| `prasanthi` | Personal development branch for Prasanthi | Prasanthi |
| `robbie` | Personal development branch for Robbie | Robbie |
| `sahil` | Personal development branch for Sahil | Sahil |

---

# 3. Branch Responsibilities

## Personal Branches

- Work only on your own branch.
- Commit and push frequently.
- Never modify another member's branch.

## Staging

- Shared collaboration branch.
- Everyone may merge completed work here.
- May contain work in progress.

## Pre-prod

- Weekly stable deliverable.
- Only Pooja merges into this branch.
- Code must be reviewed, documented, and validated before promotion.

## Main

- Final production/submission branch.
- No development occurs directly on `main`.
- Used only for the final project release.

---

# 4. Development Workflow

```text
                main
                 ▲
      Final Release
                 │
             pre-prod
                 ▲
      Weekly Review
                 │
             staging
                 ▲
      Team Integration
                 │
 Individual Branches
(pooja, prasanthi, robbie, sahil)
```

---

# 5. Weekly Development Cycle

1. Pull the latest `staging` branch.
2. Switch to your personal branch.
3. Complete your assigned work.
4. Commit regularly using meaningful commit messages.
5. Push your branch.
6. Merge your branch into `staging`.
7. Repository Manager reviews the integration.
8. Stable code is promoted to `pre-prod`.
9. At project completion, `pre-prod` is merged into `main`.

---

# 6. Common Git Commands

```bash
git checkout staging
git pull

git checkout <your-branch>

git add .
git commit -m "Meaningful commit message"
git push

git checkout staging
git pull
git merge <your-branch>
git push
```

---

# 7. Commit Message Guidelines

### Good Examples

- Cleaned Airbnb dataset
- Added tenancy API integration
- Fixed missing values
- Updated Week 5 documentation

### Avoid

- update
- changes
- test
- abc

---

# 8. Branch Protection Policy

| Branch | Policy |
|---------|--------|
| Personal branches | Direct commits allowed |
| `staging` | Team members may merge |
| `pre-prod` | Only Pooja may merge |
| `main` | Only Pooja may merge for final release |

---

# 9. Definition of Done

Before promoting `staging` to `pre-prod`:

- [ ] Code runs successfully
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Outputs verified
- [ ] Deliverable complete
- [ ] Meaningful commit history
- [ ] No unresolved merge conflicts

---

# 10. Responsibilities

## Repository Manager (Pooja)

- Review weekly deliverables.
- Resolve merge conflicts.
- Maintain `pre-prod` and `main`.

## Team Members

- Develop assigned features.
- Maintain personal branches.
- Merge completed work into `staging`.
- Notify the Repository Manager after integration.
